name: Corner Shop Row
summary: Open a street of shops and cafés on Quay Street.
briefing: The quay needs life at street level. Let 10 units, at least a few of them shops or restaurants, and reach a daily profit of $6,000 within 12 days.

events.message: Market day: retailers are looking for space

name: Walk-Up
summary: Build a profitable tower without a single elevator.
briefing: The harbour board has banned elevators on Quay Street after a string of breakdowns. Build no higher than floor 6, house or employ 70 people and keep a daily profit of $4,000.

name: Marsh Mansions
summary: Fill a Saltmere block with households on a tight loan limit.
briefing: Saltmere's harbour row needs homes. The bank only lends $1M and rents stay fixed by the town. Reach 60 residents and a reputation of 55.

name: Crown Jewel
summary: Take a Crown Yard tower to the Prime class.
briefing: Harrowgate's old money wants a new landmark. Reach the Prime class with 250 people and a reputation of 75 in 60 days. The city expects reputation 60 by day 30.

events.message: Heritage grant for reaching Class B

name: Rush Hour
summary: Move 150 people with an average wait under 25 seconds, with no staff.
briefing: A transport consultancy bets you can't keep waits short in a busy tower. House or employ 150 people and keep the average wait below 25 seconds for three closings, without hiring any staff.
